title: 心理学英语大冒险
subtitle: 序幕：心理学真的会读心吗？

story.heading: 心域学院，新生报到日
story.body: 学院里流传着一本记录心理学知识的《心域档案》。今天，档案馆却被一团“想当然”迷雾笼罩。

story.heading: 第一个误会
story.body: “学心理学的人一定知道我在想什么。”这句话变成了会复制错误说法的读心怪。

story.heading: 1879：科学之门
story.body: 从冯特建立心理学实验室开始，心理学逐渐以可观察、可检验、可重复的方法研究心灵与行为。

story.heading: 你的任务
story.body: 在校园中找到行为、心理过程和科学方法三条证据，用准确的英文概念澄清这个误会。

professorFirst.speaker: 颜教授
professorFirst.text: 欢迎来到专业英语课。先别急着背词，心理学研究的究竟是什么？

professorFirst.speaker: 阿心
professorFirst.text: Behaviors and mental processes——行为与心理过程。

professorFirst.speaker: 颜教授
professorFirst.text: 很好。去校园里找三条证据，再到实验室接受一次无惩罚摸底。

professorAgain.speaker: 颜教授
professorAgain.text: 把定义、观察和方法连接起来。科学结论不能只靠猜测。

xiaosou.speaker: 小搜
xiaosou.text: 我是小搜，负责找资料。看到放大镜标记就调查，来源比听起来厉害更重要。

xiaosou.speaker: 小搜
xiaosou.text: 取证口诀：先记下看到了什么，再判断它支持什么；不要让结论跑在观察前面。

adu.speaker: 阿读
adu.text: 我是阿读，负责拆论文。先找主张，再看作者用了什么方法支持它。

adu.speaker: 阿读
adu.text: 英语提示：scientific study 是核心，behavior 和 mental processes 缺一不可。

terms.note: 可以被观察或记录的行动与反应。
如知觉、注意、记忆、情绪和思维。
提出问题、形成假设并用系统证据检验。
建立在系统观察或实验数据之上。
the scientific study of behavior and mental processes

evidenceChallenges.title: 行为记录
evidenceChallenges.observation: 一名学生收到通知后停下脚步、皱眉，并把手机放进口袋。
evidenceChallenges.prompt: Which item is directly observable behavior?
options: The student feels disappointed by the message.
The student puts the phone into a pocket.
The student remembers the message for many years.
evidenceChallenges.success: 正确。动作可以直接记录；内在感受需要借助报告或其他测量。
evidenceChallenges.hint: 只选择现场观察者能够直接看见并记录的内容。

evidenceChallenges.title: 心理过程记录
evidenceChallenges.observation: 访谈记录写道：参与者努力回忆单词，并报告自己越来越紧张。
evidenceChallenges.prompt: Which pair names mental processes in this note?
options: memory and emotion
walking and writing
height and age
evidenceChallenges.success: 正确。记忆和情绪都属于心理过程，可以通过任务与自我报告进行研究。
evidenceChallenges.hint: 寻找发生在信息加工或主观体验中的过程。

evidenceChallenges.title: 方法流程记录
evidenceChallenges.observation: 研究者提出问题、形成可检验假设，并按统一程序收集两组数据。
options: It presents a surprising question and conclusion.
It collects systematic evidence for a testable question.
It guarantees a completely true result every time.
evidenceChallenges.success: 正确。科学方法依靠可检验问题、透明程序和系统证据，而不是保证永远正确。
evidenceChallenges.hint: 关注 testable、systematic 和 evidence 三个关键词。

options: The scientific reading of hidden private thoughts
The scientific study of behavior and mental processes
The practical study of personality advice and tips
The scientific study of brain structures and functions
diagnostic.feedback: Psychology studies both observable behavior and mental processes through scientific methods.

diagnostic.prompt: Which action is the best example of an empirical method?
options: Accepting popular beliefs without collecting relevant observations
Explaining behavior from one memorable personal experience
Recording observations through a clearly stated procedure
Selecting explanations mainly because they sound surprising
diagnostic.feedback: Empirical claims rely on observations or data collected with a transparent method.

diagnostic.prompt: Choose the logical order of a simple scientific investigation.
options: Conclusion → question → opinion → evidence
Question → hypothesis → test → conclusion
Opinion → repetition → agreement → truth
Prediction → popularity → confidence → explanation
diagnostic.feedback: A conclusion should follow a question, a testable hypothesis and evidence.

diagnostic.prompt: Which sentence makes an appropriately limited claim?
options: Psychologists can always identify thoughts in every person.
One result confirms every theory about the human mind.
This study suggests an association under these conditions.
Every human behavior results from only one simple cause.
diagnostic.feedback: Academic English often qualifies a claim with words such as suggests and under these conditions.

battleSkills.name: 定义
battleSkills.prompt: Which evidence card gives the strongest definition?
options: Psychology accurately predicts behavior and every private thought.
Psychology scientifically studies behavior and mental processes.
Psychology records whatever a trained psychologist personally believes.
battleSkills.success: 定义准确！“读心术”不能替代科学定义。
battleSkills.retry: 定义范围不准确。回想刚刚找到的 behavior 与 mental process。

battleSkills.name: 观察
battleSkills.claim: “我感觉它是真的，所以它就是真的！”
battleSkills.prompt: What should a scientific response ask for first?
options: A systematic observation using a stated test procedure
A confident explanation using a persuasive speaking style
A dramatic anecdote using a memorable personal story
battleSkills.success: 观察有效！个人确信不等于实证证据。
battleSkills.retry: 响亮的说法不是证据。寻找可以记录和复核的观察。

battleSkills.name: 比较
battleSkills.claim: “一次猜中，就证明每次都能猜中！”
battleSkills.prompt: Which comparison tests this claim better?
options: Review successful guesses across several selected examples
Compare accuracy with chance across many controlled trials
Rate each guess by how impressive it feels
battleSkills.success: 比较成立！多次受控试验才能判断表现是否超过机会水平。
battleSkills.retry: 需要明确的基线和多次试验，不能只挑一次成功。

battleSkills.name: 限定
options: This single result proves the claim for everyone.
The finding suggests a pattern under tested conditions.
This clear result requires no discussion of limitations.
battleSkills.success: 限定成功！结论回到了证据能够支持的范围。
battleSkills.retry: 科学表达需要说明条件和边界，避免绝对化。
